scripts.dev: npm run setup:env && cd Frontend-Astro && astro dev
scripts.dev:worker: npm run setup:env && cd Backend-worker && wrangler dev workers/index.js --local
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:seo
scripts.build: npm run setup:env && npm run clean && cd Frontend-Astro && astro build
scripts.deploy:database: cd Backend-worker && wrangler d1 migrations apply user-db --remote
scripts.deploy:pages: cd Frontend-Astro && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=my-astro-site
scripts.deploy: npm run setup:env && npm run test:all && npm run build && npm run deploy:database && npm run deploy:worker && npm run deploy:pages
scripts.preview: npm run setup:env && cd Frontend-Astro && astro preview
